title: SCI-S NETAPP STORAGE EVOLUTION
description: The ESA's Programmatic IT section (PIT) manages all the ESA's Science and Operations department (SCI-S) programmatic IT infrastructure, applications and services. Due to the continuous growth of data volumes and the increasing demand for flexibility, performance,availability, and operational simplicity, there is a need to evolve the current SCI-S NetApp storage system. The new infrastructuremust not only scale efficiently but also deliver enhanced capabilities to meet future enterprise storage requirements.This transformation involves a shift in architecture, moving towards a more modern and resilient platform. The goal is not only to keep pace with technological advances, but to anticipate themdeploying a solution that is robust, future-proof, and aligned with our current andfuture IT storage needs.Additionally, to complement and protect the primary storage architecture, a secondary storage system is required to enhance data resilience and support operational recovery strategies. While the primary system provides high performance and automated tiering, the secondary system acts as a dedicated snapshot repositoryensuring data is protected against accidental deletion, corruption, or system failure, without impacting the performance of the primary environment. The secondary system needs to be based on a unified HDD-based storage architecture designed for cost-effective and reliable data protection
